approved_by: user (PR #2 conversation: 「go」 to the quiet-LUFS proposal plus two added conditions)
supersedes: design §9 sentence: audio with undefined LUFS makes the gate invalid (for nonzero finite audio only)
trigger: identity_r1: C1 hit MusicGen RDCXvJPzT5k_520 (peak 0.0033, RMS 1.07e-4), integrated LUFS -inf. Evidence: harn/metric_invariance_128_identity_r1/incident/lufs_audit.json
scope: C1/C3 normalization only. Identity gate, input manifest, m, 80% pass rate, ladders, C* rule and K1-K4 decision rules unchanged.

rule.finite_lufs: unchanged: scale to -30 LUFS, no limiting
rule.nonzero_finite_audio_with_lufs_minus_inf: measure pyloudnorm on x / max|x|, scale that to -30 LUFS, no limiting; flag the clip (lufs_fallback) in every score unit
rule.zero_empty_nonfinite_or_still_undefined: invalid; run fails, no exclusion or raw substitution

condition_1_sensitivity.128a: Rebuild every cell with the ids that used the fallback in any C1/C3 unit removed, in all four modes (same cohort), and re-run C* selection and the Q3 blastnote prediction. Any changed C* or Q3 -> lufs_fallback_sensitivity.robust_to_lufs_fallback = false.
condition_1_sensitivity.128b_128c: Re-judge each K claim without pairs where either side used the fallback in C1 or C3. verdict != verdict_excl -> robust_to_lufs_fallback = false for that claim.
condition_1_sensitivity.reporting: A decision that is not robust is reported as not robust and is not used as a 128 conclusion. Counts and ids always reported.

condition_2_cpu_scan.command: python scripts/eval/metric_invariance_128.py --scan-lufs <out.json>  (under each of the 128a/128b/128c contracts)
condition_2_cpu_scan.covers: 128a: calibration records up to the largest N_a candidate x all 35 variants, and all MIDI cases; 128b/128c: every clean cell record
condition_2_cpu_scan.gate: any clip that stays invalid under the amended rule fails the scan; GPU work starts only after all three scans pass
condition_2_cpu_scan.report: n_checked, n_fallback and ids per system/cell, written before launch

bias_risk: Defined after observing the failure, before any 128 scientific result. It amplifies near-silent output (about +50 dB for the observed clip) so those clips are scored as boosted noise; condition 1 bounds the effect on conclusions.
relaunch: New source hashes, re-registered contracts and a new run id on the host; identity_r1 and its records stay unchanged.
